apps.localizedDescription: NeoFreeBird is a modified build of the official Twitter app that reverts unpopular rebranding and interface changes, restores classic features, and bundles quality-of-life modifications including BHTwitter options — built and published automatically from the project's GitHub releases. Shares com.atebits.Tweetie2 with the App Store Twitter/X app and BHTwitter: install one at a time.

Twitter 7.2.0 | NeoFreeBird-sideloaded-Twitter_7.2.0_12.33

# Version 7.2.0

## New Features
- Added an option to choose the default reply sort
- Updated X to 12.33
- Added an option to hide retweets and quotes from the “For You” page
- Added option to convert [t.co](http://t.co/) links and remove link tracking by @PEEKPerformer in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/135
- Updated NFB settings to use the new settings design. You now hold the bird (or X) on the For You page to access NFB settings
- Brought back the Tweet source labels!
- Removed the “Money” tab
- Enabling the option to hide views now also hides it in the tweet footer.

## Fixes
- Fixed more webview issues
- NeoFreeBird now more reliably filters out video ads
- Fixed hiding both the “Follow” and “Message” button on tweets by @sekiranunn in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/140
- Tweaked the wording of the “Reply in web view” option to highlight it’s a fallback by @PEEKPerformer in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/138
- Added localization support for the “Show quote numbers option”
- Fixed the app crashing when adding more than 1 account

## Localizations
* Update Japanese localization for in-app browser text by @so-5699 in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/130
* Update French localization by @jleroy in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/132
* Update Japanese localization for reply sorting options by @so-5699 in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/136
* Update Arabic localization by @ipapplus in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/139
* Update Turkish localization by @Huseyin-Korkmaz in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/142

## New Contributors
* @so-5699 made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/130
* @jleroy made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/132
* @PEEKPerformer made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/135
* @ipapplus made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/139
* @Huseyin-Korkmaz made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/142
* @sekiranunn made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/140

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/compare/v7.1.1...v7.2.0

compatibility.notes: Official IPAs from the project's GitHub releases (its own AltStore source mirrors them). The plain build is distributed here; the -noFixTwitterLogin variant on the same release is a troubleshooting fallback. Twitter 11.x+ builds require iOS 15+. Shares the Twitter bundle identifier with BHTwitter in this catalog — install one at a time.
